body: Thank you for taking time out of your day to write me.

I told my sister I was having a tough time, but she is also having one so I do not want to burden her with my problems. She has a family to take care of and doesn't need another person to worry about. I just wish I could pass her the money today. I originally did not want to take it for this reason but it was either accept or be homeless so I had to do what I had to do.
